# Roadmap

> Generated by `cairn render` from the items in [`cairn/items/`](cairn/items).
> Edit an item, not this file.

The route from an outlined book to a release candidate. Nine milestones, each
one a thing that can be held: a proven process, then the five parts in reading
order, then the apparatus, then the editorial passes.

The writing process itself is in [`docs/writing-process.md`](docs/writing-process.md).
Every chapter item carries the same checklist, so the process is visible in the
work rather than remembered.
